# Config

```{r cfg}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(data.table); library(lme4)})
set.seed(1)
# Synthetic stand-in for the pipeline state after the `clean` chunk.
# Mimics object names/structure only; numbers are meaningless.
`%||%` <- function(x, y) if (is.null(x) || length(x)==0 || all(is.na(x))) y else x

CFG <- list(outdir = "test/out", seed = 1, fdr_alpha = .05, min_cyears_item = 300,
            min_countries_item = 60, min_within_sd = .05, min_waves_within = 3)
dir.create(file.path(CFG$outdir, "tab"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
OUTCOME <- "WP16"
K <- 14
codes <- sprintf("X%02d", 1:K)
CAT <- data.table(code = c(OUTCOME, codes), label = c("Cantril", paste("Item", 1:K)),
                  domain = "d", proximity = c("outcome", rep(c("structural","perceptual"), length.out = K)),
                  direction = c(1, rep(c(1,-1), length.out = K)), vmin = c(0, rep(1, K)),
                  vmax = c(10, rep(2, K)))

impute_country_mean <- function(dt, vars) {
  for (v in vars) {
    dt[, paste0(v,"_miss") := as.integer(is.na(get(v)))]
    dt[, (v) := {
      x <- get(v); m <- mean(x, na.rm=TRUE)
      if (is.nan(m)) m <- NA_real_
      fifelse(is.na(x), m, x)
    }, by = iso3]
    # structural non-fielding: country never fielded it -> global mean + flag
    gm <- mean(dt[[v]], na.rm=TRUE)
    dt[is.na(get(v)), (v) := gm]
  }
  dt
}

## ---- DECOMPOSITION AND SCALING ----
# The two components are built from the RAW direction-corrected variable and
# are scaled on DIFFERENT reference distributions, because they answer
# different questions and live on different scales.
#
#   WITHIN  = (x - country mean), divided by the WITHIN-country SD.
#             Reads as: Cantril points per SD of movement inside a country.
#
#   BETWEEN = country mean, divided by the SD of those means ACROSS countries.
#             Reads as: Cantril points per SD of difference between countries.
#
# WHY NOT z-SCORE FIRST, THEN DECOMPOSE: within-country standardisation forces
# every country's mean to exactly zero. Taking the country mean of an already
# country-demeaned variable therefore returns a column of zeros, perfectly
# collinear with the intercept. lme4 cannot identify it and returns arbitrary
# values of order 1e14 with no significance -- i.e. the entire between-country
# half of the decomposition silently collapses. This ordering prevents that.
decompose <- function(dt, vars) {
  for (v in vars) {
    cm <- paste0(v, "_cmean")
    dt[, (cm) := mean(get(v), na.rm = TRUE), by = iso3]

    # WITHIN: deviation from own-country mean, scaled by pooled within SD.
    dev  <- dt[[v]] - dt[[cm]]
    sd_w <- sd(dev, na.rm = TRUE)
    dt[, paste0(v, "_w") := if (is.na(sd_w) || sd_w == 0) 0 else dev / sd_w]

    # BETWEEN: country mean, centred and scaled on the distribution of country
    # means (one value per country, not per country-year).
    cmu   <- unique(dt[, .(iso3, m = get(cm))], by = "iso3")$m
    mu_b  <- mean(cmu, na.rm = TRUE)
    sd_b  <- sd(cmu,  na.rm = TRUE)
    dt[, paste0(v, "_b") := if (is.na(sd_b) || sd_b == 0) 0 else (get(cm) - mu_b)/sd_b]
    dt[, (cm) := NULL]
  }
  dt
}

```

# Clean

```{r clean}
#| cache: false
# countries x years with irregular fielding
nc <- 90; yrs <- 2006:2025
cy <- CJ(iso3 = sprintf("C%03d", 1:nc), year = yrs)
cy <- cy[runif(.N) < .8]
ce <- data.table(iso3 = unique(cy$iso3), a = rnorm(nc), g = rnorm(nc), tr = rnorm(nc, 0, .02))
cy <- merge(cy, ce, by = "iso3")
# respondents
DT <- cy[rep(seq_len(.N), each = 25)]
DT[, wt := runif(.N, .5, 1.5)]
lat <- matrix(rnorm(nrow(DT) * K), ncol = K)
U <- unique(DT[, .(iso3, year)]); for (j in seq_len(K)) U[, (paste0("u", j)) := rnorm(.N, 0, .6)]
DT <- merge(DT, U, by = c("iso3", "year"))
for (j in seq_len(K)) {
  p <- plogis(0.3 * DT$a + DT[[paste0("u", j)]] + 0.2 * lat[, j] + 0.05 * (DT$year - 2015) * (j %% 3 == 0))
  yes <- runif(nrow(DT)) < p
  DT[, (codes[j]) := ifelse(yes, 2, 1)]
}
DT[, (OUTCOME) := pmin(10, pmax(0, round(5 + a + 0.8 * u1 + 0.6 * u2 - 0.4 * u3 +
                                       0.4 * (get(codes[1]) - 1.5) + rnorm(.N, 0, 2))))]
# fielding gaps: some items missing in some country-years, some never fielded
for (j in seq_len(K)) {
  drop_cy <- unique(DT[, .(iso3, year)])[runif(.N) < c(.1, .3, .6)[1 + j %% 3]]
  never <- sample(unique(DT$iso3), 5 * (j %% 4))
  DT[drop_cy, on = .(iso3, year), (codes[j]) := NA]
  DT[iso3 %in% never, (codes[j]) := NA]
}
INCLUDED <- codes[1:11]           # 3 items "fail" the screen
CANDIDATES <- codes
wave_tab <- DT[, .(n_waves = uniqueN(year), n_resp = .N), by = iso3]
wave_tab[, contributes_within := n_waves >= 3]
cov_item <- rbindlist(lapply(codes, function(cc) {
  s <- DT[, .(obs = sum(!is.na(get(cc)))), by = .(iso3, year)][obs > 0]
  cym <- DT[!is.na(get(cc)), .(m = mean(get(cc))), by = .(iso3, year)]
  data.table(code = cc, label = CAT[code == cc, label], n_cyears = nrow(s),
             n_countries = uniqueN(s$iso3),
             within_sd = cym[, .(s = sd(m)), by = iso3][, mean(s, na.rm = TRUE)])
}))
cov_item[code %in% codes[12:14], within_sd := c(.035, .045, .02)]
cov_item[code %in% INCLUDED, within_sd := pmax(within_sd, .055)]


CY <- DT[, c(lapply(.SD, function(v) weighted.mean(v, wt, na.rm = TRUE)), .(n_resp = .N)),
         by = .(iso3, year), .SDcols = INCLUDED]
for (v in INCLUDED) CY[is.nan(get(v)), (v) := NA]
CY <- merge(CY, ce[, .(iso3, gdp = exp(8 + g))], by = "iso3")
CY[, ln_gdp := log(gdp) + 0.02 * (year - 2015)]
CY <- impute_country_mean(CY, c(INCLUDED, "ln_gdp"))
CY <- decompose(CY, c(INCLUDED, "ln_gdp"))
within_countries <- wave_tab[contributes_within == TRUE, iso3]
for (v in c(INCLUDED, "ln_gdp")) CY[!iso3 %in% within_countries, paste0(v, "_w") := 0]
W_VARS <- paste0(c(INCLUDED, "ln_gdp"), "_w"); B_VARS <- paste0(c(INCLUDED, "ln_gdp"), "_b")
M_VARS <- paste0(INCLUDED, "_miss")
ANA <- merge(DT[, c("iso3", "year", "wt", OUTCOME), with = FALSE],
             CY[, c("iso3", "year", W_VARS, B_VARS, M_VARS), with = FALSE], by = c("iso3", "year"))
setnames(ANA, OUTCOME, "cantril")
AGG <- ANA[, c(.(cantril = weighted.mean(cantril, wt), n_resp = .N), lapply(.SD, first)),
           by = .(iso3, year), .SDcols = c(W_VARS, B_VARS, M_VARS)]
AGG[, `:=`(iso3 = factor(iso3), yearf = factor(year), wt = n_resp)]
# fake published T03 and T10
fwrite(data.table(code = rep(c(INCLUDED, "ln_gdp"), 2),
                  level = rep(c("within", "between"), each = length(INCLUDED) + 1),
                  estimate = rnorm(2 * (length(INCLUDED) + 1), 0, .1)),
       file.path(CFG$outdir, "tab", "T03_main_coefficients.csv"))
fwrite(data.table(code = c(INCLUDED, "ln_gdp"), order_ambiguous = FALSE),
       file.path(CFG$outdir, "tab", "T10_lead_lag.csv"))
rm(DT); invisible(gc())
message("synthetic state ready: ", nrow(CY), " country-years")
```
